name: Pramiracetam
addictionPotential: not addictive with a low potential for abuse
summary: A CNS stimulant nootropic that belongs to the racetam family of compounds. The nootropic is significantly more potent than piracetam while appearing to have a similar mechanism of action.
advisory: Usually taken two or three times a day. 400mg taken three times a day, or 600mg three times a day.
doseBasis: Note: Usually taken two or three times a day. 400mg taken three times a day, or 600mg three times a day.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of pramiracetam is not well known, but it is thought to be able to enhance high-affinity choline uptake in a manner which is similar to other compounds of the racetam family. As choline is responsible for acetylcholine synthesis, this process essentially allows acetylcholine to accumulate at higher levels than that which it otherwise would.

uses.text: It is marketed by Menarini under the brand name Pramistar as a treatment for memory and attention deficits in aging people with neurodegenerative and vascular dementias in Italy and some Eastern European countries. CNI obtained the orphan designation for the ECT use from the FDA in 1991, which was later withdrawn when CNI abandoned the drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known from research. Small studies and user reports describe headache, nervousness, sleep problems and stomach upset.
sideEffects.zh: 相關研究很少。小型研究和使用者報告提到頭痛、緊張、睡眠問題和腸胃不適。
sideEffects.zhHans: 相关研究很少。小型研究和用户报告提到头痛、紧张、睡眠问题和肠胃不适。

fact.en: Unlike piracetam, pramiracetam carries a bulky side chain with two isopropyl groups on a nitrogen atom, which makes the molecule much larger and more fat-loving.
fact.zh: 和吡拉西坦不同，pramiracetam 帶有一條較大的側鏈，其氮原子上連著兩個異丙基，使分子更大、也更親脂。
fact.zhHans: 和吡拉西坦不同，pramiracetam 带有一条较大的侧链，其氮原子上连着两个异丙基，使分子更大、也更亲脂。
